mission: Audit the 12 highest-commercial-value pages of utilityexplained.com (the 6 money/affiliate pages + 6 flagship traffic pages listed in context) per .squad/SQ-065/audit-prompt.md. Produce one full audit entry per page in the standard format, PLUS a slice-level judgment on monetization trust: do affiliate placements (product boxes, inline links) help or corrupt the reader's decision; are disclosures honest and visible; are product claims (savings figures, payback periods) supported; any YMYL/consumer-risk language problems. Write the full per-page table to .squad/SQ-065/wave1/lieutenant-pages.md. This is the site's revenue core — be unsparing.
parent_objective: SQ-065: Full-scale 9-section content/SEO/UX audit of utilityexplained.com (114 pages) per operator audit prompt — cloud-only formation
context: READ FIRST: .squad/SQ-065/audit-prompt.md (operator's verbatim criteria — your audit standard). Your assigned pages (content/blog/<slug>.md): [MONEY] do-home-energy-monitors-save-money, do-programmable-thermostats-cut-heating-bills, 50-best-smart-plugs-standby-power, 42-best-energy-efficient-space-heater, point-sensor-vs-whole-home-water-leak-when-to-upgrade, do-thermal-curtains-really-work; [FLAGSHIP] 01-how-to-read-your-electric-bill, 03-why-is-my-electric-bill-so-high, 05-how-to-lower-utility-bills, 06-water-bill-too-high, 07-gas-bill-too-high, how-to-lower-electric-bill-complete-guide. Read each page's markdown IN FULL (frontmatter + shortcodes + body). Entry format per page: '### /blog/<slug>/ — <title>' then purpose/intent, quality N/10, seo N/10, weaknesses, ai_slop (patterns + quoted phrases, or 'none'), visual_gaps, action (improve|merge->slug|redirect|noindex|remove|keep) + next steps. Ground every rating in quoted evidence — confidence is not evidence.
